waveform_and_geometry.doppler_sign_convention: fD=-2*v/lambda; positive receding velocity gives negative Doppler
waveform_and_geometry.range_epoch: t=0 is the common PRI/transmit epoch
waveform_and_geometry.delay_convention: tau=2R/c; evaluate the continuous waveform at each sample

quantizer.rounding: round to nearest, ties away from zero

spectral_noise.normalization: No realization normalization, mean removal, or spectrum flattening

noise_and_adc.noise_generation_dependency: Private mt19937ar RandStreams with explicit Gaussian spectral synthesis; no Communications Toolbox AWGN
noise_and_adc.noise_only_estimator: Mean power from one fixed-seed record per path over the stationary, complete-valid ROI
noise_and_adc.adc_headroom_rule: Report A1+A2 plus frozen-noise peak and observed extrema; never rescale
